copy.description: This grooming glove is made for brushing loose fur from your cat during everyday grooming. The maker describes the bristle side as soft silicone and the glove body as mesh cloth. A flexible wrist cuff keeps the glove on your hand without extra straps, and it fits a range of hand sizes. Use it for everyday cleaning, grooming, and bath time. The maker lists it for short, long, and curly fur, on small, medium, and large cats, and also for dogs and rabbits. It is a simple tool to keep near the spot where you usually brush your pet, so a quick grooming session is easy to start. Each order includes one glove, shipped in a plastic bag. Check the shipping estimate before you order, since delivery times can vary.

faq.a: It fits a range of hand sizes. The flexible wrist cuff helps it stay on your hand without extra straps.

faq.q: What coat types does it work on?
faq.a: It works on short, long, and curly fur, on small, medium, and large cats.
Estimated 3–8 business days to the US, plus processing 1–3 days. These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.
